description: Batch execution of liquid formulations in the eight DCS-controlled blend tanks, including aqueous ammonia and hydrogen peroxide additions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 80% of volume runs in Blend Hall A (about $237K of shipments per production day); a loss of control of the ammonia process is a toxic release hazard; RPO 24 h matches the nightly DCS configuration export
manual_workaround: Stop Blend Hall A and hold tanks in a safe state; Blend Hall B can run about 15% of formulations manually (non-ammonia products only)
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-13 (OT workstations)
dependent_third_parties: DCS integrator; DCS vendor support; raw material suppliers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Blend operators; Shift Supervisors; Controls Engineer; control room

business_process: Process safety monitoring and emergency shutdown
description: SIS trips, ammonia gas detection, tank high-level and high-pressure protection, remote isolation valves
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without the SIS the ammonia and peroxide tanks must stay isolated with portable detectors and a standby watch; the EHS Manager limits this to one shift. RPO 0: the SIS logic must match the approved copy exactly
manual_workaround: Isolate tanks with manual valves; portable ammonia detectors; stop all transfers; standby watch per the emergency action plan
dependent_people_or_facilities: Instrument and Electrical Technicians; Shift Supervisors; EHS Manager

business_process: Raw material receiving and tank farm
description: Rail and truck unloading into bulk tanks (including aqueous ammonia unloading), level monitoring, transfers to blend tanks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Unloading ammonia or peroxide without trusted level readings risks overfill; railcar demurrage and supplier schedules
manual_workaround: Suspend unloading; manual tank gauging each shift; railcars held on the siding
dependent_third_parties: Rail carrier; chemical suppliers; tank truck carriers

description: Master recipes in the batch management system and bills of materials in the ERP; recipe changes under MOC
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Recipes are needed to restart BP-01; a lost or altered recipe can create an incompatible mixture; 420 formulations are trade secrets
manual_workaround: Printed recipe cards for the top 40 formulations in the control room binder (to be created); ERP bill of materials as a cross-check

description: Sampling, lab testing, LIMS results, certificates of analysis, batch release
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No shipment leaves without a certificate of analysis; customers audit batch records
manual_workaround: Paper lab worksheets and manually typed certificates for up to 2 days

description: Filling drums, totes, and pails on four packaging lines with PLC-controlled fillers and labelers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Finished goods inventory covers about 2 days of drum and tote orders
manual_workaround: Manual filling on scales at reduced rate; pre-printed labels from the ERP

business_process: Order management, shipping, and loading rack
description: Customer orders, bulk truck loading at the rack, bills of lading, hazardous materials shipping papers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 25 truckloads a day; hazardous materials shipping papers must be accurate; customers such as water utilities have limited storage
manual_workaround: Paper orders and pre-printed shipping papers; rack operated in local mode with two-person verification

business_process: Hazardous materials inventory and site security
description: Inventory accountability for hydrogen peroxide and other chemicals; badge access, cameras, gate control
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Theft or diversion of 50% hydrogen peroxide is a security concern (legacy CFATS COI); camera and badge outages need guards
manual_workaround: Guard posted at the gate 24 hours; daily physical tank and tote counts

description: Calling county fire rescue and 911, the National Response Center, the LEPC and SERC; RMP and release records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Release notifications are due immediately (40 CFR 302.6; 355.43); the RMP notification mechanism must work when the business network is down
manual_workaround: Printed call list and cellular phones in the control room and gatehouse; handheld radio to the gate
dependent_people_or_facilities: Shift Supervisors; EHS Manager; Plant Manager

description: Raw material purchasing, supplier payments, customer invoicing and collections
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow; supplier terms allow short delays; bank portal is separate
manual_workaround: Phone orders to key suppliers; invoices queued in the ERP

mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; terminations must still remove access the same day
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the provider; manual termination checklist
